gaps: Free-float penetration report has ONE live vintage (2025-11-30); prior months are removed from the live site.
Statistics history is ~42 non-contiguous archived months (2015-09..2024-06) and stops there.
Part A covers 29,350 securities against the statistics page's 732 listed + 59,217 unlisted; residual flagged, unexplained.
1,150 of 7,956 documents have no date-bearing URL path; 1,950 were bulk-uploaded in 2015.
Holder-level positions and the 9-class investor taxonomy are not published by CDC.
cdcsrsl.com (CDC Share Registrar Services) is separately Cloudflare-challenged and not mapped.

novel_features.name: Coverage map + paginator integrity
novel_features.description: See exactly which document buckets are mirrored, which are genuinely absent at source, and which were never asked for.
novel_features.rationale: Duplicate detection is cross-request by definition, and a coverage map without persisted negatives cannot distinguish 'CDC never published this' from 'we never asked'.
novel_features.why_it_matters: Run this before trusting any other command's completeness; it is the only command that writes the document index.

novel_features.name: Identity ledger and point-in-time resolve
novel_features.description: Reconstruct a security's symbol, name and ISIN history so you never splice two different issuers into one return series.
novel_features.rationale: Requires diffing retained security-list vintages against dated symbol-change notices; CDC publishes snapshots and never a diff.
novel_features.why_it_matters: Reach for this before joining CDC data to any symbol-keyed price series; symbol recycling silently corrupts factor research.

novel_features.name: CDS eligibility state machine
novel_features.description: Get a security's full CDS-eligibility history folded from twenty years of notices into a six-state lifecycle.
novel_features.rationale: No state endpoint exists; eligibility state is only the fold of a complete 7,639-document crawl spanning 2007 to 2026.
novel_features.why_it_matters: Use for CDS-eligibility history, but note CDS eligibility is not the same as PSX trading suspension and is not a tradability gate.

novel_features.name: Row-level extraction audit
novel_features.description: Prove the PDF extraction is trustworthy by asserting the report's own percentage column against its own share and capital columns.
novel_features.rationale: No reference parser for these split PDFs exists anywhere, so an internal-consistency audit is the only available correctness bar.
novel_features.why_it_matters: Run this before any analysis that depends on the penetration numbers; residual signatures tell you which column drifted.

novel_features.name: Schema and seam gate
novel_features.description: Refuse to blend vintages whose column sets are incompatible, and refuse a month that is missing one of its parts.
novel_features.rationale: Proven necessary: the two comparable vintages differ by a dropped Market Value column, two added columns, and a twenty-four-fold universe change.
novel_features.why_it_matters: Run this whenever a new vintage lands; it blocks silently-incompatible data instead of averaging it.

novel_features.name: Three-way float reconciliation
novel_features.description: Put CDC custody penetration beside PSX free-float shares and NCCPL free-float percent, with each denominator named.
novel_features.rationale: The CDC leg exists in no package or dataset anywhere; the other two legs are already in your local store.
novel_features.why_it_matters: Use this to see where the three float definitions disagree; it deliberately never blends them into one number.

novel_features.name: Per-symbol Government of Pakistan stake
novel_features.description: Derive state-held capital per security from the difference between the including-GoP and excluding-GoP capital columns.
novel_features.rationale: No Pakistani source publishes per-symbol state ownership in machine-readable form, and the exchange carries heavy state-owned-enterprise weight.
novel_features.why_it_matters: Use for a current cross-section of state ownership; there is only one vintage, so no time series exists.

novel_features.name: Append-only statistics history
novel_features.description: Track the sixteen CDS aggregate metrics forward from your first sync, with archived rows labelled as such.
novel_features.rationale: The statistics page is overwritten monthly, so a given month's figures cease to exist once the next month lands unless you snapshotted them.
novel_features.why_it_matters: Use to measure retail-participation growth; archived rows are non-contiguous and must never be read as a continuous series.

narrative.headline: The only machine-readable view of Pakistani custody data — per-security CDS penetration and a twenty-year eligibility record, from a source no tool has ever automated.
narrative.value_prop: CDC publishes the sole per-security custody-penetration figures in the Pakistani market as split PDFs behind a bot challenge, with no API and no history endpoint. This CLI mints a browser clearance once, replays it over plain HTTP, and turns the downloads corpus into a queryable local store. `coverage map` proves what is mirrored, `identity ledger` stops symbol recycling from corrupting your return series, and `eligibility state` folds two decades of notices into a per-security lifecycle.
narrative.auth_narrative: CDC sits behind a Cloudflare JS challenge on every path. Run `auth login --chrome` once: it opens a real browser, clears the challenge, and stores the clearance cookie together with the exact User-Agent that minted it, because the cookie is bound to that User-Agent. The clearance has a measured hard lifetime of roughly thirty minutes regardless of traffic — the cookie's own expiry field claims a year and is not to be trusted. Every command checks the remaining margin before starting work and refuses early rather than dying midway through a fan-out.

quickstart.comment: confirm the binary, config path and store are healthy before touching the network
build the document index first; nothing else can be trusted as complete until this runs
read one security's CDS-eligibility lifecycle out of the local store
check whether this symbol was ever reused by a different issuer
prove the penetration extraction before using the numbers

troubleshoots.symptom: Every command returns a clearance-expired error
troubleshoots.fix: Run `auth login --chrome` again; the clearance has a hard ~30-minute lifetime and cannot be renewed without a browser.

troubleshoots.symptom: A command refuses immediately with 'clearance margin too small'
troubleshoots.fix: That is deliberate — re-mint with `auth login --chrome` rather than starting work that cannot finish.

troubleshoots.symptom: coverage map stopped partway with chunks remaining
troubleshoots.fix: Re-run `auth login --chrome` then re-run the same command; it re-derives what is missing from the store and resumes.

troubleshoots.symptom: A vintage load is refused for schema drift
troubleshoots.fix: Inspect with `verify schema --vintage <date>`; CDC has changed columns before, so acknowledge the new fingerprint deliberately rather than blending.

troubleshoots.symptom: float triangulate returns rows with an empty CDC leg
troubleshoots.fix: Part B of the report covers mutual-fund units and carries no paid-up capital, so no penetration percentage exists for those ISINs.

narrative.when_to_use: Reach for this CLI when you need Pakistani custody-layer facts that exist nowhere else in machine-readable form: what share of a security's capital sits in the central depository, whether a symbol has been reused by a different issuer, or when a security entered or left CDS eligibility. It is also the right tool when you need to prove a local mirror is complete before running research on it.
anti_triggers: Do not use this CLI for holder-level or sub-account positions — CDC does not publish them, they require an individual investor's own login.
Do not use it for the nine-class investor taxonomy that NCCPL and MUFAP publish — CDC exposes only Individual versus Corporate, at aggregate level.
Do not use it for daily prices, volumes or index data — that is the PSX CLI's surface.
Do not use it to determine whether a security is tradable today — CDS eligibility is a custody status, not a trading suspension.
Do not ask it for a free-float time series — only one live vintage of the penetration report exists.

recipes.explanation: Returns the tri-state coverage per bucket so you can tell a genuine source gap from an unasked question.

recipes.explanation: The full event payload is large; selecting three dotted paths keeps an agent's context small while preserving the audit trail.

recipes.explanation: Lists securities where the Government of Pakistan holds at least a quarter of paid-up capital.

recipes.title: Catch a symbol collision before a join
recipes.explanation: Returns the identity in force on that date, or NOT_IN_VINTAGE rather than guessing.

recipes.title: Audit an extraction end to end
recipes.explanation: Surfaces only the failing checks and the ISINs they belong to.
